# thetalake_retention_library (Data Source)

The retention library data source enables lookup of retention library IDs by name

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thetalake_retention_library" "example" {
  name = "Example Retention Library"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the retention library to look up

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The retention library ID
